title: REQ · HeaderOverlay shows logo, world, round ID, status, countdown, sound toggle and settings from the UI store
summary: HeaderOverlay component driven by props and useUiStore
description: Context: no HeaderOverlay exists. Desired behavior: a presentational component taking worldTitle, round (loading|error|ready) and rendering the six elements, with sound and settings buttons bound to useUiStore. Expected result: compact top overlay with accessible buttons. Why: header requirement of the redesign.
acceptance_criteria: Given a ready round, when rendered, then StoryForge, world title, round id, status badge and a timer are shown
Given loading state, when rendered, then text 'Loading round…' is shown and no timer
Given error state with a message, when rendered, then the message is shown and 'Round unavailable' alone is not
Given clicks on the Sound and Settings buttons, when the store is read, then soundEnabled and settingsOpen are toggled and aria-pressed reflects state
technical_constraints: Reuse Countdown and RoundBadge; Lucide Volume2/VolumeX/Settings icons; Button from ./ui/button
